event.description: Keep only top-eight causal attention logits with one QKV union
event.proposal: Family: attention organization. Current retained frontier is 1,640 parameters at 99.000000%, exactly threshold. There have been 23 prior macro-attempts in this family. The most recent accepted result is attempt-0146/micro-0011 at 1,640/99.00%; the most recent failed result is attempt-0153, whose squared-ReLU attention scored 0.00% at 1,639. Hypothesis: exponential competition is essential, but its diffuse low-probability tail is redundant; retaining the top eight causal logits preserves the strongest column/carry routes. Add QKV pair 608/539, mask all but the top eight available logits when T>8, and retain incumbent softmax/temperature, yielding 1,639 parameters. This is more informative than top four because eight is the least restrictive sparsification that materially affects later sequence positions.
